title: azedarach sempervirens var. australasica
intro: Azedarach sempervirens var. australasica, commonly known as the Australian native or Australian sweet pepperbush, is a plant species in the Meliaceae family. It is valued for its leaves and flowers, which have been traditionally used in various cultures for their medicinal properties. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it useful for treating wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include azadirone, meliacine, and other limonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
